reasoning_content:
The swagger.json is located at /swagger/v1/swagger.json. Next, let's test the protected endpoints:
1. Without a token → 401
2. With a user token (app-access + editor) → 200

action.command: echo "=== no token (expect 401) ==="; curl -s --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:5000/api/Strasse?skip=0&take=1"; echo "=== with valid user token (expect 200) ==="; UTOK=$(cat /tmp/user-token.txt); curl -s --max-time 10 -H "Authorization: Bearer $UTOK" "http://localhost:5000/api/Strasse?skip=0&take=1" -o /tmp/strasse-resp.json -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"; head -c 300 /tmp/strasse-resp.json
